freeze_statement: Repair coefficients were selected inside predeclared overall, balanced, and per-class task-label accuracy budgets using a metadata-blind frozen-slice objective; an exact no-op was eligible. Each active repair received a newly initialized, seed-matched cross-fitted Fisher adversary and final validation-trained gate; an exact no-op reused the identical frozen ERM adversary. test_blind.npz and sealed_metadata.npz remained unopened.

repair_protocol.fisher_penalty: dimensionless F_initial/(F_current+epsilon); equals one at warm start
repair_protocol.fresh_adversary_seed_matching: original ERM, no-op, continuation, and all repair arms use identical gate initialization, cross-fit partition, fold, and final-discovery seeds

head.checkpoint_metric: binary NLL at temperature 1; step zero is eligible

repair_protocol.matched_erm_continuation: same warm start, fresh AdamW optimizer, checkpoint split, early-stopping rule, and maximum additional steps with both penalties zero
repair_protocol.selection: task-label-only overall/balanced/per-class safety envelope, then frozen-slice loss, Fisher, or joint Pareto criterion; an exact no-op candidate is always included
repair_protocol.temperature_convention: the base model's independently calibrated temperature is frozen for Fisher training, validation selection, fresh-adversary discovery, and later test certification for every repair arm

fresh_adversary.initialization: new parameters with initialization/fold seeds matched to ERM and every other arm

selection.criterion: Pareto frontier in frozen-slice loss/Fisher, then maximum worst relative improvement; ties prefer the smaller normalized coefficient
selection.rule: First require overall, balanced, and both per-class task-label accuracies to remain within their fixed budgets. Then optimize the arm-specific frozen-slice criterion without metadata.

fresh_adversary.initialization: new parameters with initialization/fold seeds matched to ERM and every repair arm

selection.rule: Matched warm-start/checkpoint control; no coefficient selection.

fresh_adversary.initialization: exact no-op: reused the matched original ERM adversary and frozen gate

selection.criterion: maximum fixed-temperature predictive Fisher on the frozen original slice
